annotations.title: Audit Pre-Route Vendor Stackup, 50-Ohm RF & VIPPO Rules

description: Validate multi-layer vendor stackup before routing to compute exact 50-Ohm RF width (mm), 3*H1 top ground-pour pullback (mm), reference-plane corridor half-width, and VIPPO policy. Call before routing BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRa, cellular, or GNSS boards. Accepts H1 (mm), Er, and outer copper (um); returns JSON RF constraints. Example: top_prepreg_h1_mm=0.19, prepreg_er=4.29.

outer_copper_um.description: Finished outer copper thickness in micrometers (35.0 = 1 oz).

pcb_text.description: Optional raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb text for board context audit.

prepreg_er.description: Relative permittivity Er of the top prepreg dielectric (>= 1.5).

project_path.description: Optional local filesystem path to .kicad_pcb file (STDIO mode).

top_prepreg_h1_mm.description: Top prepreg height H1 between F.Cu and In1.Cu (mm).

transmission_line_mode.description: RF line mode: isolated_microstrip (3*H1 pullback) or cpwg waveguide.

vippo_mode.description: Via-in-Pad policy: standard SMT disallow_via_in_paste or IPC-4761 allow_vippo_type_vii.

name: audit_pre_route_rf_and_fab_stackup
title: Audit Pre-Route Vendor Stackup, 50-Ohm RF & VIPPO Rules
